title: Spore becomes the registration tier
summary:
Spore became the starting tier, model defaults got a clearer home, and gateway-to-backend request failures got a fix.

New accounts now start on Spore rather than Seed. Enter shows the new tier, subscription routes recognize it, and the Pollen FAQ no longer promises Seed’s daily Pollen to new registrants. Subscription status matching was also corrected.

Enter’s chat completions use `openai` when no model is specified. The text and image backends no longer silently substitute their own models; requests that reach them without a valid model are rejected instead.

A configuration mismatch behind 403 responses on gateway-to-backend text and image requests was corrected. Proxy handling and authenticated text and audio tests were also tidied up.
